svg.title: ADBC hex badge isometric construction grid
svg.text: ADBC hex badge · isometric construction grid
The ring is centred on the whole stack, top face included. Every edge lands on the triangle grid; the ring’s vertical sides on its half grid.
upper sides: a gap above the top face
lower sides: a 4th layer’s front walls
The logomark’s own: equilateral triangles, grid lines three ways (vertical and ±30°),
all equally spaced. True isometric: view angle = arcsin(1/√3) ≈ 35.26°.
Regular and centred on the whole stack, top face included (rows 0–23). That is a row taller
than a regular hexagon, so the ring clears the top face and the bottom walls by 3 grid lines (a gap)
and the side walls by 3½; its vertical sides fall on the half grid. The ring is 2 lines thick, like the walls.
Its lower sides sit where a 4th layer’s front walls would; its upper sides mirror them, a gap
Edges run only in the hexagon’s three directions: every angle is 60° or 120°.
Cut out of the bottom layer’s front walls, so the badge stays one colour. Each line is centred
on its wall and starts ½ cell from the wall’s end. “ADBC”: Barlow Bold, caps 1 cell (half a wall),
from the left end. URL: Roboto Condensed Regular, x‑height ½ cell, to the right end.
16½ cells wide × 33 tall (16½√3 : 33 = √3 : 2): 33 grid lines each way. Mark 11 × 23 inside.
